hints.title: Tracking Surviving Sequence Head
hints.text: Rather than maintaining all remaining numbers, only trace the position of the first element in the surviving sequence.

hints.title: Direction and Parity Head Updates
hints.text: The head shifts forward when eliminating from left to right, or when eliminating from right to left if the count of remaining elements is odd.

hints.title: Step Doubling Simulation
hints.text: Initialize head = 1, step = 1, remaining = n, left = True. While remaining > 1, if left or remaining % 2 == 1, add step to head. Double step, halve remaining, and invert left.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def lastRemaining(self, n: int) -> int:
        head = 1
        step = 1
        remaining = n
        left = True
        while remaining > 1:
            if left or remaining % 2 == 1:
                head += step
            remaining //= 2
            step *= 2
            left = not left
        return head
```

variables: N: number of elements in game
complexity.notes: Optimal logarithmic O(log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space simulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining explicit arrays or linked lists takes O(N) space and quadratic operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating arithmetic progression parameters tracks the survivor without arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that halving remaining elements per pass yields O(log N) steps.
